From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan & Next Steps

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the technical evaluation milestone. High level recap and next steps below: 

- Goal: Complete technical evaluation and benchmark by 2027-04-08 to inform procurement decision targeted for 2027-04-22.
- Proposed technical milestone (MAP): "Technical evaluation plan" — deliverables: benchmark results vs success criteria, latency/cost summary, model shortlist recommendation, integration notes.
- Responsibilities: Acme will provide test corpus + evaluation priority list; Redwood will provide sandbox access, benchmark harness, and a recommended model shortlist.
- Dependencies: Access to a representative sample dataset (PII redacted), procurement of sandbox credentials, and a 2-hour tech deep-dive next week.

I've attached: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.docx and technical_eval_criteria.xlsx (first-pass success criteria / metrics). Please review and confirm the ownership and target dates.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Acme confirms dataset delivery date and point of contact.
2) Redwood schedules sandbox + SSO access (if needed).
3) Align on latency/cost targets in the criteria doc.

Would you be able to confirm the dataset delivery target by EOD tomorrow? If that works we'll slot the sandbox provisioning for 2027-03-25.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft_v1.docx, technical_eval_criteria.xlsx

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP draft. A few quick clarifying items from our side: 

- Dataset: We can deliver a 50k-token redacted sample by 2027-03-24. Point of contact will be me (Samir).
- Success criteria: On latency we need 95th percentile <= 350ms for single-turn queries at 256 tokens. Cost target: operating cost <= $0.35 per 1k tokens (post-optimization). Are those reasonable to include as target metrics?
- Model shortlist: Can you send the recommended shortlist with expected perf/cost tradeoffs? We want 2 high-quality larger models + 1 efficient LLM option.
- Sandbox access: We need SSO support (Okta).

Happy to hop on a short technical call Wednesday to kick off — 10–11am PT works for our infra lead.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of AI Engineering | Acme Corp
samir.khan@acme.com

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan & Next Steps

Thanks Samir — great to see those targets. Quick responses and an updated plan below (pulling in internal owners).

1) Dataset delivery: noted for 2027-03-24 (Samir POC). Redwood will await the S3 link and a short schema descriptor file.

2) Latency/cost targets: We can commit to including your targets as "benchmark success criteria" in the MAP draft. Notes:
   - 95p latency target: 350ms at 256 tokens is ambitious but achievable on dedicated GPU profiles with batching turned off for single-turn p99/95 testing. We'll include test configs for both single-request latency and 99/95 under 10qps sustained.
   - Cost: $0.35/1k tokens target — we'll quantify pre/post-optimization and include recommended quantization/packing settings that preserve quality.

3) Model shortlist (initial recommendation):
   - Llama-3 70B (opt-in): expected best-quality baseline; likely higher cost.
   - RedPajama-INCITE-70B (tunable): strong open large-model candidate for instruction tasks.
   - Mistral-Instruct-7B (efficient): low-latency, cost-effective option for baseline and fallbacks.

We'll produce a short performance/cost estimate matrix for each model and run benchmarks in the Redwood sandbox.

4) Sandbox + SSO: Rishi (cc'd) will own sandbox provisioning and Okta SSO. Rishi — can you confirm SSO steps and ETA?

5) Technical call: Wed 2027-03-24 10:00–11:00 PT works for our infra lead. I'll send a calendar invite.

I've attached a refreshed technical_eval_criteria.xlsx with explicit metric rows and the current MAP draft updated with milestones and owners.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: technical_eval_criteria.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan & Next Steps

Quick update on provisioning and initial perf expectations:

- Okta SSO: We can onboard Acme via SAML. I need the IdP metadata from Samir to configure. ETA: 24–48 hours after we get metadata.
- Sandbox timeline: We'll stand up a dedicated sandbox cluster on 2027-03-25 if dataset is delivered 03-24.
- Initial latency/cost estimates (rough):
   - Llama-3 70B: 95p latency ~420ms (single-request), estimated cost $1.20 / 1k tokens unoptimized.
   - RedPajama-INCITE-70B: 95p latency ~390ms, cost ~$0.95 / 1k tokens unoptimized.
   - Mistral-Instruct-7B: 95p latency ~210ms, cost ~$0.22 / 1k tokens unoptimized.

We will run the standardized benchmark harness (attached) and share results within 7 business days of sandbox availability. I'll also add an internal task for model quantization experiments to hit the $0.35/1k tokens target for the larger models.

-Rishi
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
